title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Subscription to AWS Lambda
description: Create a CloudWatch Logs subscription to a Lambda function

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to create a log subscription in Cloudwath Logs, Lambda as a log receiver.
Using filter rules, we can control the logs that sends to Lambda function.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
